_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 1% directional hit rate over 7 days and no breaker present (ETF flows at 0, VIX elevated, MVRV dropping), HOLD is the statistically honest call until confirmation signals fire.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative implies a coiled breakout is coming but does not commit to direction or timing, creating a split on forward outlook despite agreeing on current conditions
next_move.invalidated_if: vix > 70 AND DXY > 103 AND btc_momentum_30d drops below 45
